'''Jikesh Valia''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of an [[Emergency firespeeder/Legends|emergency firespeeder]]<ref name="Cross-Sections">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> in [[Fire Team Three/Legends|Fire Team Three]], a division of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Coruscant Rescue Ops/Legends|Coruscant Rescue Ops]]<ref name="DB Firefighters" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Cross-Sections" /> a conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] that lasted from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]<ref name="Cross-Sections" /> in 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="ROTS date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Valia [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] her<ref name="CSWE" /> firespeeder to the aid of the falling Separatist [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''[[Invisible Hand/Legends|Invisible Hand]]'',<ref name="Cross-Sections" /> and helped tamp down its flames after the crippled [[Starship/Legends|starship]]<ref name="CSWE" /> was successfully crash-landed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Fireman [[Pont Edisser/Legends|Pont Edisser]] served aboard Valia's vessel.<ref name="CSWE Edisser">{{CSWECite|I|226|Edisser, Pont}}</ref>

While piloting her vehicle, Valia wore a [[Color/Legends|gray]], white, and yellow<ref name="CSWE" /> insulated<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> [[Clothing/Legends|suit]] with a [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] that possessed an integrated heads-up display, [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], heat-resistant faceplate, and [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-supplied [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]]. She also wore gray [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]] with impregnated [[Lead/Legends|lead]] bootguards<ref name="ROTSVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> carrying<ref name="CSWE" /> compact fire-suppression equipment.<ref name="SWCTP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jikesh Valia was first mentioned by the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', written by [[Curtis Saxton]]<ref name="Cross-Sections" /> and released on [[April 2]], [[2005]].<ref name="Cross-Sections release date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/release/publishing/news20041124.html|text=Planning Your Episode III Bookshelf}}</ref> Simultaneously,<ref name="ROTSVD release date">{{DK|url=us/9780756611286-star-wars-revenge-of-the-sith-the-visual-dictionary|text=Star Wars Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary|nolive=1}}</ref> Valia was first pictured by ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'' by [[James Luceno]],<ref name="ROTSVD" /> though the connection between Valia and the pictured firefighter would not be made until Valia received an entry in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /> Valia's name was misspelled as "Jikesh Valai" by the earlier entry for Pont Edisser in the encyclopedia.<ref name="CSWE Edisser" />
